meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作短动态图形视频，如动效文字、数据动画或品牌标识
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成无旁白的动态图形视频
copy.tagline_en: Create short motion graphics like kinetic typography, data animations, or brand stings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce short, narration-free motion graphic videos

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude制作短动画：动态文字、数字跳动、图表动画、标志展示、地图动画、网页或UI动画等。输出MP4或透明视频，时长通常10秒内，无旁白。
howto.when: 当你要求制作一个简短、设计感强、以动效传达信息的动画时触发。如果内容较长或有旁白，会转给其他技能。

say.text: 帮我做一个公司标志的出场动画。
把这句话做成动态文字视频：“创新永不止步”。
用这些数据做一个柱状图动画：A:30, B:50, C:20。

howto.what_en: This skill makes short motion graphics: kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz, logo sting, lower-third, animated map, animated tweet/news/headline, webpage/UI animation, or fusing image geometry into a chart. Outputs MP4 or transparent overlay, usually under 10s, no narration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message. For longer or narrated content, it routes to another skill.

say_en.text: Create a logo reveal animation for my company.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a logo-reveal motion graphic.

say_en.text: Animate this quote: 'Innovation never stops' as kinetic typography.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a kinetic-type animation.

say_en.text: Make a bar chart animation from data: A:30, B:50, C:20.
say_en.note: Claude will create a charts category animation.
